title: ledger-entry/1
description: The append-only record against the monthly cap (GLOSSARY: Ledger, Reservation, Monthly cap). Month-to-date = settle amounts + open reserves at their ceilings + fixed lines, for the UTC calendar month (T-09); overrun entries mark an excess already inside the settle amount and block new leases until acknowledged; a reconcile_adjustment books an invoice charge the ledger never saw, counts in month-to-date and also blocks new leases until acknowledged (monthly reconciliation can raise the total, and may lower only an amount settled at the ceiling). Changing the cap and acknowledging an overrun are owner acts.
